---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an enhancement for the HUD teleprompter, launcher, or hotkeys
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature.

### Problem / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a specific workflow problem? (e.g. "When presenting 45-minute technical keynotes in Zoom, I need...")

### Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you would like to see:
- **Component**:
  - [ ] Overlay HUD Prompter (e.g. Guide bar customization, mirroring, margins, opacity)
  - [ ] Dark Glass Launcher (e.g. Script editor, markdown import/export, script timing)
  - [ ] Global Shortcuts & Control (e.g. Foot pedal support, custom keybinds)
  - [ ] Platform / Invisibility (e.g. Multi-window exclusion, virtual camera integration)
- **Detailed Behavior**:
  Explain how the feature should behave and feel to the user.

### Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or workarounds you've evaluated.

### Visual Design / Mockups
If applicable, add sketches, UI mockups, or design ideas adhering to the Dark Glass / Cyber Cyan (`#00F0FF`) palette.

### Additional Context
Add any other context, performance considerations, or references here.
